title: $70K and Still Broke
segments: This guy makes seventy thousand dollars a year, and by the 28th he has two hundred bucks left.
Here’s the three things nobody tells you.
One: every raise gets spent. Income goes up, so rent, car and takeout go up right behind it.
Two: invisible subscriptions. Four streaming apps, a gym you don’t use, a delivery membership. That’s easily two hundred dollars a month.
Three: cash sitting in a savings account paying almost nothing, while inflation quietly shrinks it.
The fix: split every raise, half for your life, half invested automatically. Follow for part two.
description: Why you can earn $70K and still feel broke. Not financial advice.
